proposal_text: Stale confirmations after promotion: three enrichment workers (enri-a-05, enri-a-11, enri-a-23) were promoted from version 1 to version 2 this period. Their confirmations are now stale — previously valid for v1 but not re-confirmed for v2. The system allowed promotion without invalidating or requiring renewal of the confirmation. Recommend that promotion automatically marks prior confirmations as stale and blocks or flags the worker until a fresh confirmation is logged for the new version.
